<title level="1" right="Focus 1" pfs="Standard">
[Spinning Staff](/Spells.aspx?ID=2884)
<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Magus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=953" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 180

<row gap="medium">

 

**Requirements** You’re wielding a staff.
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You spin your staff with an impossibly quick twirling flourish, attacking two foes and transforming the momentum into magical energy to charge for your next [Spellstrike](/Actions.aspx?ID=4260). Make a melee [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) with your staff against one foe and then a second melee Strike with your staff against a different foe. Your multiple attack penalty applies to both of these attacks as normal.
name: Spinning Staff
